entries.decision: Keep a Common V2.1 StopInformationRequest with repeated StopName XSD-valid; optionally explain that the PDF states a stricter 0:1 maximum.
guards: official Common V2.1 strict profile only
match only StopInformationRequest with more than one StopName element
must not impose the PDF 0:1 maximum as an extra validator rule

entries.decision: Decorate only an actual Common V2.3 XSD INVALID result caused by ArrivalExpected or DepartureExpected being placed inside StopInformationRequest as documented by the PDF.
guards: official Common V2.3 strict profile only
match only exact ArrivalExpected or DepartureExpected child in StopInformationRequest
must not register these fields as request aliases
must preserve their valid placement in StopInformationStructure
must not rewrite or relocate invalid request XML automatically

evidence: EV-119 / Common V2.1 exact-authority executable evidence
EV-121 / Common V2.3 exact-authority executable evidence
